Astronomers may have discovered a black hole born before the first stars
stories.t: A mysterious object named Phoebe, detected when it briefly magnified a distant star, could be a primordial black hole formed just after the Big Bang.

stories.h: Scientists discover mysterious lakes more than a mile beneath the Red Sea
stories.t: More than a mile beneath the surface of the Red Sea, scientists have discovered rare underwater lakes that could reveal secrets about Earth's ancient oceans and the possibility of alien life.

stories.h: Recent sinking of Russian vessels abroad shows the Russia-Ukraine war has officially gone global
stories.t: For Ukraine to have any chance of winning the war against Russia, it must increase the pressure on Vladimir Putin’s government. Making Russian assets vulnerable globally is one way to do it.
